target: डॉक्टर ने मुझे तीन दिन की दवा दी।
english: The doctor gave me three days' worth of medicine.
reason: "नीम हकीम ख़तरे की घंटी" is a proverb/motto, not a sentence anyone says, and it does not carry the node's ने-perfective pattern. Replacement is a plain ने + को/मुझे + object perfective in a situation a learner actually hits.

target: उसने जल्दी से शर्ट के बटन लगाए।
english: He quickly buttoned up his shirt.
reason: Pointless (a doorman fastening uniform buttons) and the agreement is wrong — बटन is masculine, so "बटन लगाई" is ungrammatical. Replacement keeps ने-perfective + बटन लगाना with correct agreement and an everyday subject.

target: दर्ज़ी ने इस कपड़े से कुर्ता सिल दिया।
english: The tailor made a kurta from this cloth.
reason: Museum-caption trivia; मूर्तिकार/संगमरमर is vocabulary a learner will never use. Replacement keeps the same ने + material-से + बनाना/सिलना pattern with a trade people really deal with in India.

english: I fed the children rice and dal.
reason: Rural set-dressing (bullocks, fodder) that a learner will not say. Replacement keeps the identical ने + को + खिलाया causative frame with everyday vocabulary.

target: नाराज़ बच्चे ने खिलौना फेंक दिया।
english: The upset child threw the toy away.
reason: तूलिका is literary/archaic for paintbrush (spoken Hindi is ब्रश), and the scene is decorative. Replacement keeps adjective + subject + ने + फेंक दिया with words people use.

target: उसने छोटे-मोटे काम करके गुज़ारा किया।
english: He got by doing odd jobs.
reason: A fakir living by begging is niche period-piece content. Replacement keeps the same करके conjunctive-participle + गुज़ारा किया structure in an ordinary situation.

target: बारी-बारी से सब अपना नाम बताइए।
english: Please tell us your names one by one.
reason: "Do multiplication and division alternately" is not something anyone says — classroom-worksheet translationese. Replacement keeps बारी-बारी से + imperative in a real, common instruction.

target: मैं छाता लेकर घर से निकला।
english: I left the house carrying an umbrella.
reason: A sadhu with a कमंडल is archaic, niche vocabulary. Replacement keeps the लेकर + motion-verb pattern with an object a learner will actually carry.

target: इस ट्रैफ़िक में समय पर पहुँचना कठिन है।
english: It's hard to get there on time in this traffic.
reason: Farming barren land is content a learner will never use, and it duplicates hi-2479's बंजर theme. Replacement keeps the infinitive-as-subject + कठिन है pattern in a daily-life complaint.

target: थकान तो थी, फिर भी वह काम पर चला गया।
english: He was tired, but he still went to work.
reason: Reads like a moral parable about the persevering farmer. Replacement keeps the same तो … फिर भी concessive pattern in an ordinary situation.

target: बच्चा रोता हुआ कमरे से बाहर आया।
english: The child came out of the room crying.
reason: Storybook trivia (croaking frog) with no everyday use. Replacement keeps the identical "-ता हुआ" participle + motion-verb structure with a scene a learner will describe.

target: दुकानदार ने हमसे पूरे पैसे वसूल किए।
english: The shopkeeper collected the full amount from us.
reason: Zamindars collecting लगान is historical content, not modern speech. Replacement keeps the X से Y वसूल करना pattern in a situation that comes up while shopping.

target: फ़ोन करके सबको ख़बर दे दी।
english: I called and let everyone know.
reason: मुनादी (proclamation by drum) is archaic and unusable. Replacement keeps the same करके + inform structure (subject dropped, as in the original) with a modern action.

target: मैंने सुई-धागे से कुर्ते का बटन टाँक दिया।
english: I sewed the kurta's button back on with a needle and thread.
reason: Unnatural — you do not sew a button on with a sewing machine, and the sentence has no subject. Replacement keeps the instrumental से + टाँकना with the right tool and a stated subject.

target: दुकान सुबह नौ बजे खोली जाती है।
english: The shop is opened at nine in the morning.
reason: Courtroom officialese (life sentence) in a deck teaching everyday speech. Replacement keeps the passive (…जाती है / …गया) in a sentence a learner might genuinely produce.

target: पुराना सामान कमरे से हटा दिया गया।
english: The old stuff was cleared out of the room.
reason: Pure bureaucratic register — illegal encroachment on government land. Replacement keeps the same agentless passive + से with household content.

target: चाबी के बिना दरवाज़ा नहीं खुलेगा।
english: The door won't open without the key.
reason: A signboard, not speech ("Entry prohibited without permission"). Replacement keeps के बिना + negated future in an everyday sentence.

english: Listen Manish, come here a moment.
reason: "ओय" plus the तू imperative "आ" is rude register a learner should not be taught to use. Replacement keeps the vocative + ज़रा + imperative in ordinary polite-familiar speech.
